entries.name: Clenow counter-trend (Trading Evolved ch. 17)

entries.name: Volatility-managed NIFTY exposure (Moreira & Muir 2017)
entries.rule_as_coded: weights = 1 / vol[1] per month where vol = frollapply(ret, 22, var); wret = weights x ret; in-sample c = sd(ret) / sd(wret) over the whole sample; out-of-sample c = rolling(960) sd ratio at the month's first day
bug_fixes: in-sample c uses the full-sample standard deviations (look-ahead): replaced by an EXPANDING-window c (all history to the decision close)

the monthly weight 1/vol[1] is the 22-day variance ending ON the month's first day, i.e. it includes the first day's own return: replaced by Moreira-Muir's previous-calendar-month realised variance (sum of squared daily returns), known at the month-end close
the out-of-sample c (rolling 960 days, read on the month's first day) has the same same-day overlap: expanding c read at the month-end close

defaults_fixed_before_any_run.weight: w = min(1.5, c / RV_prev): leverage cap 1.5 (plain default fixed here; not in the source)
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.c: std(daily NIFTY returns) / std(r_d / RV of the month before d), both over all history to the decision (uncapped series); first weight once 12 monthly RVs exist (era 1: data from 2012-01, first decision 2013-01-31; era 2: history spliced, first decision 2023-11-30)
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.instrument: NIFTY index futures exposure on the spot index (cash at 0 %, no basis / roll / financing; the same for the benchmark), futures statutory costs + 1 bps per side, executed at the next open; units held between rebalances
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.benchmark: buy-and-hold NIFTY (weight 1 from the same first decision, same cost model)
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.gates: PASS = managed Sharpe > buy-and-hold Sharpe in era-1 H1 (to 2017-12-31), era-1 H2 and era 2, AND managed max drawdown shallower than buy-and-hold in era 1 and era 2; CAGR reported (not a gate)

entries.name: Turtle Soup and Turtle Soup Plus One (Street Smarts, book rules)
entries.source: Raschke & Connors, Street Smarts (1995); ports nerdyckc/turtle_soup_bitmex and raghav-rathi turtle_soup
entries.rule_as_coded: nerdyckc: troughs / peaks from scipy argrelextrema(order=n) - a CENTRED window that needs n FUTURE bars; raghav: close back above the violated 20-bar low within 3 bars, market entry
bug_fixes: no argrelextrema (look-ahead) and not the 3-bar close-back-inside variant: the book's rules

defaults_fixed_before_any_run.turtle_soup: prior 20-day low P = lowest low of the 20 sessions before the trade day, made >= 4 sessions before it (most recent occurrence on ties); the trade day must trade below P (a new 20-day low), then a buy stop at P + 5 ticks, good for that day only; initial stop 1 tick under that day's low; mirror short on the 20-day high. If both sides set up, the side whose arm level is nearer the decision close
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.turtle_soup_plus_one: day one: low below the prior 20-day low P (lowest low of the 20 sessions before day one, made >= 3 sessions earlier) and close at / below P; day two: buy stop at P, day two only; stop 1 tick under the lower of the day-one / day-two lows; mirror short
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.exit: the book's trailing stop is not specified: initial stop, else out at the close of the 5th session (max_hold 5) - one plain default for both
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.fill: round-7 resting entry order (sim.py _order_trade / api.Swing.entry): valid for the next `valid` sessions only; buy stop fills at max(open, level) (+ slippage); an ARMED stop (Turtle Soup) needs the session to trade beyond the arm level and then fills AT the level - daily bars cannot order the high and the low, so a session that reaches both counts as filled (pessimistic: the unknown cases are the ones that close below the level); limit fills only one tick through (no slippage); on the fill session only the protective stop is checked (taken as after the fill); targets and rule exits start at the close of the fill session / next session; 'one tick under today's low' stops are fixed at the fill session's close. Unfilled: no trade, re-asked the next session. Both eras use the same DAILY-bar fill (no minute data is used for the fill)

entries.source: shortlist rule; pysystemtrade rules/carry.py for the carry idea

entries.note: Overlap with r4_oi_basis_hi_short_5d / r4_oi_basis_lo_long_5d (tested): those are per-stock TIME-SERIES z-scores (vs the stock's own last 60 sessions) of the NEAR future's premium over the CASH close, event trades held 5 sessions with a 5 % stop on the cash price. Carry here is the CROSS-SECTIONAL rank of the calendar slope between the front and the second contract (no spot leg), a weekly market-neutral book, P&L on the contracts (the roll yield). Related through the basis, not the same rule; r5_kite_vars_calendar_v2 (near-next spread mean reversion within one stock) is the other neighbour.

defaults_fixed_before_any_run.80-20: yesterday opened in the top 20 % of its range and closed in the bottom 20 % (lab daily bars: 09:15 open, 15:29 close); today trades >= 5 ticks below yesterday's low, then a buy stop at yesterday's low; stop 1 tick under today's low so far; out at the 15:15 square-off (the book's trailing stop is not specified); mirror short
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.oops: today opens below yesterday's low -> buy stop at yesterday's low; stop 1 tick under today's low so far; out at 15:15 (Williams exits on the close); mirror on an open above yesterday's high
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.fill: the lab's intraday convention for a stop entry: decided at the close of the first minute that trades at / through the level after arming (the arming minute itself only if it closes beyond the level), filled at the next minute's open (+ slippage); fills before 15:15
defaults_fixed_before_any_run.instruments: stocks (MIS, long / short, Rs 1 lakh, 2 bps) and index future (underlying NIFTY / BANKNIFTY: spot index bars stand in for the future, 1 lot, 2026 lot sizes 65 / 30, futures costs, 1 bps slippage; 2.5 bps sensitivity)

entries.name: Connors TPS scale-in on NIFTY / BANKNIFTY
entries.rule_as_coded: long: close > SMA200, RSI(2) < 25 two days -> 10 %; each close below the last entry adds 20 / 30 / 40 %; exit RSI(2) > 70; mirror short; trades at the close
bug_fixes: the port's RSI is EMA-smoothed: Connors' Wilder RSI(2) is used

defaults_fixed_before_any_run.size: 100 % = 1 lot (fractional tranches), futures costs per tranche, 1 bps
